title: A 700-year-old stupa above old Beijing's roofs | Beijing, Walked EP4 | China Travel Expert
description:
A sea of grey roofs — and one white stupa above them.

Real footage over old Beijing's hutong rooftops: courtyard houses below, and the White Stupa Temple rising over a skyline that has barely changed. The stupa is more than 700 years old.

🧭 Expert Tip: the streets under the stupa are pure old Beijing — walk them, don't just photograph the tower.

白塔寺：灰瓦屋顶海之上，一座七百多岁的白塔。
